prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.6 °C (69% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.8 °C (51% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.2 °C (59% above healthy). Thermal equilibrium is compromised, causing fluid temperature to rise well above nominal operating limits.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.76 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.47 s (2% above healthy). Hydraulic valve exhibits slight transient lag while maintaining target pressure.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 1298 W·min/l (239% above healthy); FS1 mean volume flow 2.09 l/min (68% below healthy); SE system efficiency factor 19.8 % (66% below healthy). Significant reduction in delivered volume flow at nominal electrical power indicates severe internal pump slippage.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 59.0 bar (27% above healthy). Marked pressure ripple and reduced peak pressure indicate severe loss of hydraulic accumulator gas pre-charge.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.5 °C (69% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.9 °C (51% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.2 °C (59% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.40 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.64 s (within 2% of healthy). Directional valve actuates cleanly with no discernible switching hesitation.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.34 l/min (49% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 784 W·min/l (104% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 31.1 % (47% below healthy). Volumetric delivery is slightly compromised due to minor internal bypass flow.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 56.6 bar (21% above healthy). Slight increase in pressure oscillations indicates reduced surge dampening capacity.
